log.text: Choosing the equator lane as it is the fastest to reach (3.4 days), which minimizes unproductive transit time and maximizes our active cruise time near major volcanic centers.
We should stay in the equator lane because traveling to the north or south lanes would consume almost all of our remaining 9 days, leaving too little time to observe any events.
